a_probe.definition: A2 logistic probe re-derived on the frozen phi; ECE/Brier on the held-out val split

b_grp.definition: 24-permutation softmax of checkpoints/grp.pth vs the game-final rank_by_player; primary = top-1 confidence ECE/Brier on the pre-registered sample

primary.sample: files[2000:] of the k=10000 seed=13 draw

train_frequency_reference.definition: constant predictor p_k = empirical permutation frequency (fit half), evaluated on the held-out half

probed_subset.sample: files[:2000] (pre-run timing probe subset; transparency only)

c_dqn.definition: DQN Q values of the pinned checkpoint: softmax action-confidence calibration (tau=1 primary, tau=0.05 sensitivity) + value-scale table vs the exact training target

summary_ece.note: these three are the numbers that feed docs/exp-gates.md (todo 15)

gate.threshold_audit: ECE > 0.05 => allow (triage / readiness gate for the belief line, todo 15)
gate.threshold_delivery: belief-head delivery gate (todo 29): ECE <= 0.15; NOT the same as the 0.05 triage gate
